_readme: Real captures, masked for privacy (see landing/README.md and docs/backend-handoff or the explainer project's BUILD-NOTES.md for the mask log). js/config.js's demoReelUrl overrides clip-demo-reel with an external embed when set.

items.alt: The Kora explainer: a driver's shift end to end, narrated over real app captures.
Screen recording: the driver asks for the next delivery and the route draws on the map.
Screen recording: a new order is offered and the driver accepts it out loud.
Screen recording: Kora keeps listening for a quick follow-up after the wake word.
Screen recording: the shift summary screen with today's activity and the order queue.
Kora's voice screen with the chrome orb, next stop, target and the lime listening button.
Kora's map screen with the route to the next stop and the trip card.
A new delivery offer card with a countdown, distance and time window, and Accept and Decline buttons.
Kora's summary screen with today's activity, the daily target and the order queue.
Kora's settings screen: auto-accept rules and the wake word controls, including wake sensitivity and wake on greetings.
